description_en: This API operation is used to modify the draft definition of an API. It is different from the ModifyApi operation in that it does not require all information about the API. You need to only specify the parameters that you want to modify. For example, if you want to change the authentication method of the API from Anonymous to APP, you need to only specify the value of AuthType, which is APP
description_zh: 本API用于修改API的草稿定义信息，区别于接口ModifyApi，不需要填充所有的API信息才能操作，只需指定要修改的参数进行修改。例如，当需要修改API的认证方式从匿名变为APP认证，只需要传入AuthType的值APP即可
name: ModifyApiConfiguration

parameters.help_en: The ID of the API
parameters.help_zh: API的ID标识
parameters.name: api_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the API
parameters.help_zh: API名称
parameters.name: api_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the API
parameters.help_zh: api描述
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to make the API public. Valid values:

PUBLIC: The API is public. If this parameter is set to PUBLIC, the API is displayed on the APIs page for all users after the API is published to the production environment.

PRIVATE: The API is private. Private APIs are not displayed in the Alibaba Cloud Marketplace after the API group to which they belong is made available
parameters.help_zh:
API是否公开，可以取值：

PUBLIC：公开，如选择此类型，该API的线上环境定义，会在所有用户的控制台“发现API”页面可见。
PRIVATE：不公开，如选择此类型，当该组API在云市场上架时，私有类型的API不会上架
parameters.name: visibility

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to forcibly check X-Ca-Nonce. If the ForceNonceCheck parameter is set to true, X-Ca-Nonce is forcibly checked. X-Ca-Nonce is the unique identifier of the request and is generally identified by UUID. After receiving this parameter, API Gateway verifies the validity of this parameter. The same value can be used only once within 15 minutes. This helps prevent replay attacks.

If the ForceNonceCheck parameter is set to false, X-Ca-Nonce is not checked. If you do not modify this parameter when you modify an API, the original value is used
parameters.help_zh:
设置ForceNonceCheck为true, 请求时强制检查X-Ca-Nonce，这个是请求的唯一标识，一般使用UUID来标识。API网关收到这个参数后会校验这个参数的有效性，同样的值，15分内只能被使用一次。可以有效防止API的重放攻击。
设置ForceNonceCheck为false, 则不检查。修改时，不设置则不修改原来的取值
parameters.name: force_nonce_check

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to call the API only in an internal network. If the DisableInternet parameter is set to true, the API can be called only in an internal network.

If the DisableInternet parameter is set to false, the API can be called over the Internet and in an internal network
parameters.help_zh:
设置DisableInternet为true, 仅支持内网调用API。
设置DisableInternet为false, 则不限制调用
parameters.name: disable_internet

parameters.help_en:
If the AuthType parameter is set to APP, the valid values are:

DEFAULT: The default value that is used if no other values are passed. This value indicates that the settings of the group are used.

DISABLE: The authentication is disabled.

HEADER: AppCode can be placed in the Header parameter for authentication.

HEADER_QUERY: AppCode can be placed in the Header or Query parameter for authentication
parameters.help_zh:
当AuthType为APP认证时，可选值如下：

DEFAULT：不传默认是DEFAULT（随分组设置）
DISABLE：不允许
HEADER：允许AppCode的Header认证
HEADER_QUERY：允许AppCode的Header及Query认证
parameters.name: app_code_auth_type

parameters.help_en:
If the AuthType parameter is set to APP, you must include this parameter to specify the signature algorithm. If you do not specify a value, HmacSHA256 is used by default. Valid values:

HmacSHA256

HmacSHA1,HmacSHA256
parameters.help_zh:
当AuthType为APP认证时，需要传该值明确签名算法。可选值如下，不传默认是HmacSHA256：

HmacSHA256
HmacSHA1,HmacSHA256
parameters.name: allow_signature_method

parameters.help_en:
API Security authentication type,Valid values::

APP:Only authorized APP Call

ANONYMOUS:Allow anonymous calls,Exercise caution when you allow anonymous calls.:

Anyone who can obtain this API person who can access service information,can call this API.The gateway does not authenticate callers.,You cannot configure user-level throttling either.,If you expose this API Configure API traffic throttling;

AppCodeAuthType does not take effect
parameters.help_zh:
API安全认证类型，目前可以取值：

APP：只允许已授权的APP调用
ANONYMOUS：允许匿名调用，设置为允许匿名调用需要注意：
     - 任何能够获取该API服务信息的人，都将能够调用该API。网关不会对调用者做身份认证，也无法设置按用户的流量控制，若开放该API请设置好按API的流量控制；
     - AppCodeAuthType的值不会生效
parameters.name: auth_type

parameters.help_en: The protocol type supported by the API. Valid values: HTTP and HTTPS. Separate multiple values with commas (,), such as "HTTP,HTTPS"
parameters.help_zh: API 支持的协议类型，可以多选，多选情况下以英文逗号隔开，如：”HTTP,HTTPS”，取值为：HTTP、HTTPS
parameters.name: request_protocol

parameters.help_en: The HTTP method used to make the request. Valid values: GET, POST, DELETE, PUT, HEADER, TRACE, PATCH, CONNECT, and OPTIONS
parameters.help_zh: HTTP Method，取值为：GET、POST、DELETE、PUT、HEADER、TRACE、PATCH、CONNECT、OPTIONS
parameters.name: request_http_method

parameters.help_en: The path of the API request. If the complete API URL is `http://api.a.com:8080/object/add?key1=value1&key2=value2`, the path of the API request is `/object/add`
parameters.help_zh: API path，比如API的完全地址为`http://api.a.com：8080/object/add?key1=value1&key2=value2`，path是指`/object/add`这一部分
parameters.name: request_path

parameters.help_en:
The request mode. Valid values:

MAPPING: Parameters are mapped. Unknown parameters are filtered out.

PASSTHROUGH: Parameters are passed through.

MAPPING_PASSTHROUGH: Parameters are mapped. Unknown parameters are passed through
parameters.help_zh:
入参请求的模式，取值为：

MAPPING：入参映射（过滤未知参数）

PASSTHROUGH：入参透传

MAPPING_PASSTHROUGH：入参映射（透传未知参数）
parameters.name: request_mode

parameters.help_en:
This parameter takes effect only when the RequestMode parameter is set to MAPPING.

The format in which data is transmitted to the server for POST and PUT requests. Valid values: FORM and STREAM. FORM indicates that data is transmitted in the key-value pair format. STREAM indicates that data is transmitted as byte streams
parameters.help_zh:
当RequestMode值为MAPPING时有效。

POST/PUT请求时，表示数据以何种方式传递给服务器，取值为：FORM、STREAM，分别表示表单形式(k-v对应)、字节流形式
parameters.name: body_format

parameters.help_en: The description of the request body
parameters.help_zh: 请求body描述
parameters.name: post_body_description

parameters.help_en: The body model
parameters.help_zh: body模型
parameters.name: body_model

parameters.help_en: The name of the model
parameters.help_zh: 模型的名称
parameters.name: model_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the backend service. This parameter takes effect only when the UseBackendService parameter is set to TRUE
parameters.help_zh:
后端服务名称
UseBackendService置为TRUE时才会生效
parameters.name: backend_name

parameters.help_en:
The protocol that is used to access backend services. Valid values:

Http: for backend services that use HTTP or HTTPS

Vpc: for backend services that use VPC

FC: for Function Compute

OSS: for Object Storage Service

Mock: for backend services that use the Mock mode

EventBridge: for EventBridge

You must specify the config value for the corresponding backend service
parameters.help_zh:
后端服务协议类型，目前支持：
Http： http/https后端
Vpc： Vpc后端
FC： 函数计算后端
OSS： 对象存储后端
Mock： mock后端
EventBridge： 事件总线后端

需要指明对应后端服务的配置信息，即为对应的后端服务的config参数赋值
parameters.name: service_protocol

parameters.help_en: The HTTP configuration
parameters.help_zh: http配置信息
parameters.name: http_config

parameters.help_en: The VPC configuration
parameters.help_zh: vpc配置
parameters.name: vpc_config

parameters.help_en: The Function Compute configuration
parameters.help_zh: 函数计算配置信息
parameters.name: function_compute_config

parameters.help_en: The OSS configuration
parameters.help_zh: OSS配置信息
parameters.name: oss_config

parameters.help_en: The Mock configuration
parameters.help_zh: Mock配置信息
parameters.name: mock_config

parameters.help_en: The timeout period of the backend service. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 后端服务超时时间，单位：毫秒
parameters.name: service_timeout

parameters.help_en:
The ContentType configuration of the backend request.

DEFAULT: the default configuration in API Gateway

CUSTOM: a custom configuration
parameters.help_zh:
后端请求ContentType配置
DEFAULT：API网关默认
CUSTOM：自定义
parameters.name: content_type_category

parameters.help_en: The value of the ContentType header when the ServiceProtocol parameter is set to HTTP and the ContentTypeCatagory parameter is set to DEFAULT or CUSTOM
parameters.help_zh: 调用后端服务HTTP服务，ContentTypeCatagory的值为DEFAULT或者CUSTOM时，ContentType头的取值
parameters.name: content_type_value

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/43986.html
parameters.help_zh:
Consumer向网关发送API请求的参数描述。

Consumer向网关发送请求的参数和网关向后端服务发送的请求的参数的映射关系。

更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/43989.html

parameters.help_en: The format of the response from the backend service. Valid values: JSON, TEXT, BINARY, XML, and HTML. This value is used only to generate documents. It does not affect the returned result
parameters.help_zh:
后端服务返回应答的格式，目前可以设置为：JSON、TEXT、BINARY、XML、HTML。
该值仅用于生成文档使用。不对返回结果产生影响
parameters.name: result_type

后端服务返回应答的示例
该值仅用于生成文档使用。不对返回结果产生影响

后端服务失败返回应答的示例
该值仅用于生成文档使用。不对返回结果产生影响

The sample error codes returned by the backend service.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/44392.html

后端服务返回的错误码示例。

更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/44392.html
parameters.name: error_code_samples

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the information about the created backend service. Valid values:

TRUE: uses the information about the created backend service.

FALSE: uses the information about the custom backend service
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用创建的后端服务资源：
TRUE：使用创建的后端服务
FALSE：自定义后端服务信息
parameters.name: use_backend_service
